name: Bertan Dirikolu
bio: Born 1980 in Batman, Turkey, Bertan Dirikolu is a Turkish actor.

credits.title: Mutter: The Diary of a Mother
credits.overview: On the fog-drenched Black Sea coast, a woman gives birth to a being that defies nature. As her body and mind begin to unravel, love becomes both her devotion and her disease.

credits.title: Dabbetü'l-Arz: Kıyamet
credits.overview: All pregnant women living in the village where Rukye teacher Cemil lives begin to experience a curse. After Cemil teacher burns the entire jinn tribe to break this curse, everything becomes irreversible.

credits.overview: A film by Elif Akarsu Polat and Cigdem Bozali.

credits.title: The Obsolete One
credits.overview: A brand new bust is brought to a small village. State officials who brought it forget to take back the obsolete one. The only teacher at the village school, Şeref, assigns the duty of protecting the old one to the janitor İzzet. This burden will lead İzzet’s life to an impasse.

credits.title: The Storm
credits.overview: Cemal comes to Istanbul from a small Kurdish town after finishing high-school to pursue higher education. He feels isolated and out of place in the crowded city and soon meets a group Kurdish students who are against the repressive Turkish political system.
